title: Job: Who Can Contend with God?

questions.question: How can a man be in the right before whom?
questions.explanation: Job 9:2 (ESV): "Truly I know that it is so: But how can a man be in the right before God?"

questions.question: If one wished to contend with Him, could he answer Him?
options: Not once in a thousand times
questions.correctAnswer: Not once in a thousand times
questions.explanation: Job 9:3 (ESV): "If one wished to contend with him, one could not answer him once in a thousand times."

questions.question: Who removes mountains?
questions.explanation: Job 9:5 (ESV): "he who removes mountains, and they know it not, when he overturns them in his anger,"

questions.question: What does God do to the sun?
questions.explanation: Job 9:7 (ESV): "who commands the sun, and it does not rise; who seals up the stars;"

questions.question: What constellations did God make?
questions.explanation: Job 9:9 (ESV): "who made the Bear and Orion, the Pleiades and the chambers of the south;"

questions.question: When He passes me, do I see Him?
options: No, I do not see him
questions.correctAnswer: No, I do not see him
questions.explanation: Job 9:11 (ESV): "Behold, he passes by me, and I see him not; he moves on, but I do not perceive him."

questions.question: What if I am righteous?
options: I cannot answer him; I must appeal for mercy
questions.correctAnswer: I cannot answer him; I must appeal for mercy
questions.explanation: Job 9:15 (ESV): "Though I am in the right, I cannot answer him; I must appeal for mercy to my accuser."

questions.question: He destroys both the blameless and the who?
questions.explanation: Job 9:22 (ESV): "It is all one; therefore I say, 'He destroys both the blameless and the wicked.'"

questions.question: The earth is given into the hand of the who?
questions.explanation: Job 9:24 (ESV): "The earth is given into the hand of the wicked; he covers the faces of its judges..."

questions.question: My days are swifter than what?
questions.explanation: Job 9:25 (ESV): "My days are swifter than a runner; they flee away; they see no good."

questions.question: Even if I wash myself with snow and cleanse my hands with lye, what will God do?
questions.explanation: Job 9:30–31 (ESV): "If I wash myself with snow... then you will plunge me into a pit, and my own clothes will abhor me."

questions.question: What is lacking between Job and God?
questions.explanation: Job 9:33 (ESV): "There is no arbiter between us, who might lay his hand on us both."

questions.question: What monsters/helpers bowed beneath God?
questions.explanation: Job 9:13 (ESV): "God will not turn back his anger; beneath him bowed the helpers of Rahab."

questions.question: How does God multiply Job's wounds?
questions.explanation: Job 9:17 (ESV): "he who crushes me with a tempest and multiplies my wounds without cause;"

questions.question: If I say, "I will forget my complaint," what happens?
options: I become afraid of all my suffering
questions.correctAnswer: I become afraid of all my suffering
questions.explanation: Job 9:27–28 (ESV): "...I become afraid of all my suffering, for I know you will not hold me innocent."

key_verse_text: Who does great things beyond searching out, and marvelous things beyond number.
